instruction: A chunky wooden toy train locomotive made of simple turned and blocky painted parts — round wheels, a cylindrical boiler, a cabin and a smokestack — in cheerful primary colors with a smooth matte paint and soft rounded edges.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of ONE wooden toy train engine in a painted wooden toy style. A chunky wooden toy train locomotive made of simple turned and blocky painted parts — round wheels, a cylindrical boiler, a cabin and a smokestack — in cheerful primary colors with a smooth matte paint and soft rounded edges. Procedural three.js geometry, style-appropriate materials and lighting, orbit controls, single centered object.
